ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Polymarket is looking for a Mobile Infrastructure Engineer to own mobile infrastructure end-to-end: the release pipeline, CI, test infrastructure, stability, and observability that let a small mobile platform team ship a high-traffic trading product quickly and safely. You'll also help build our AI layer — the harnesses, evaluations, and developer tooling that make AI a first-class part of how we build and ship mobile software.

This is a generalist, hands-on role. You'll build and operate the tooling behind how the team ships — release automation, CI, test infrastructure, observability — and extend that toolchain with AI. The work spans services and code: alongside the pipelines and dashboards, you'll go into the app itself to fix crash clusters and harden error paths. We're looking for someone who has kept a high-traffic consumer mobile product shipping reliably.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the release tooling across iOS and Android: automated builds, code signing, store submission, phased rollouts, hotfix paths, and post-release health checks after every deployment

 - Build and maintain CI infrastructure that earns trust: build-time budgets, flaky-test detection and quarantine, merge gates, and device and simulator infrastructure that keeps feedback loops short

 - Build the quality tooling: regression gates and automated coverage that let the team set and defend crash-free and ANR targets — and go directly into app code to fix crash clusters and harden error paths when the tooling surfaces them

 - Run the observability stack and alerting that surfaces problems before users feel them

 - Build AI into the mobile toolchain: create evaluation harnesses for AI-assisted features, embed AI agents into developer workflows, and make AI a first-class part of how the team ships and tests

 - Measure everything: set budgets, track them over time, and prove improvements with data rather than instinct




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Broad mobile infrastructure experience at consumer scale, including CI/CD, release automation, test infrastructure, and stability work on iOS, Android, or both

 - Hands-on experience with mobile release tooling: crash reporting and monitoring with Sentry or similar, feature flagging with LaunchDarkly or similar, and release automation with fastlane or an equivalent

 - Practical experience applying AI to engineering work: building evaluation harnesses, integrating LLM-powered features, or embedding AI agents into developer workflows

 - Measurement-driven approach to quality — you instrument, set budgets, and prove improvements rather than operating on gut feel

 - Willingness to go into app code when the tooling surfaces problems — you can fix crash clusters and harden error paths yourself while your core ownership stays the tooling and infrastructure around the app

 - Generalist temperament: comfortable owning the tooling for release, CI, quality, observability, and AI at the same time on a small team, and able to drive each area without heavy oversight

 - (Plus) Familiarity with real-time data applications, live market feeds, or trading products on mobile

 - (Plus) Background in fintech or other data-intensive consumer mobile products




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

 - 401k match

 - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories




PAY TRANSPARENCY

Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.
